verdict.rationale: Speechmatics offers asynchronous batch jobs (docs-2, docs-23), so a job-completion webhook is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a registrable callback or notification URL that fires when a job completes or fails. Batch processing and job deletion are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, a webhook or callback fires when a job completes or fails, so nothing in my system has to poll
